name: Pigman's Prize Pears

start.dialog: Oink! My pears! Best in Uplands! Need delivered to Iron Chef in the Mire! But careful - Dominion checkpoint on the route! Hide them well! Oink!
start.objective: Deliver a crate of pears to Iron Chef in the Mire without Dominion inspection

progress.dialog: Pears still good? Not bruised? Dominion soldiers steal food! Be careful! Oink!
progress.objective: Navigate around Dominion checkpoints with the pear crate

complete.dialog: These pears! PERFECT! Pigman Brown delivers again! Here - smoked ham hock. Best in the Mire! Don't tell him I gave you this!

party_comments.kade: Smuggling fruit. Didn't expect this in my hero journey.
party_comments.korr: Avoiding checkpoints. Now THAT I can do.
party_comments.twist: Pears! I love pears! Can we eat just one?

hidden_outcome: If you bluff your way through the checkpoint using forged papers (found nearby), Pigman gives you access to his 'secret orchard' with rare golden pears
